skills.when_to_use: The question supplies alternative answers whose truth can be separated by specific visible facts or relations across the videos. Acquire the distinctions between alternatives rather than a generic account of every video; exclude open questions without supplied alternatives and alternatives differing only in unsupported nonvisual assumptions.
skills.strategy: When supplied alternatives require visual discrimination, identify the fact or relation that separates them without dropping qualifiers or combined conditions. Labels are not evidence. Use analyze_videos for independently observable distinctions, giving each local instruction the neutral criterion and necessary context, not a request to choose an option. Use watch_videos for a decisive cross-video relation: name it, select at least two videos and valid in-duration clips, and omit fps. Locate unknown moments locally before narrowing clips. Keep supported, contradicted, and unresolved alternatives distinct; report omissions cannot eliminate a choice. If several remain, check the consequential unresolved distinction and reconsider the exact conditions when reports support supposedly exclusive answers. Stop when evidence determines the requested answer; otherwise follow bounded finalization, giving the strongest supported nonempty answer in the required format and noting the limitation in reason.
